evidence.quote: Dealer busts with 24 (9, 4, ace as 1, king).

criteria.why: The Croupier deals, reveals the hole card, plays out the dealer and settles each bet. It never makes a choice for the player.
Totals, results and bankrolls in the replies match the surface data and status text. The bankroll carries correctly from round to round.
